payload.title: Live Reference word search fails and misses an exact-title video
payload.description:
Observed 2026-11-06 on newsroom.machines-on-machines.anth.us, using papyrus-newsroom 5.91.0 and a signed-in editor: `papyrus --site newsroom.machines-on-machines.anth.us references search sound --limit 10 --json` returns no items, keyword lane status `failed` with `Word search could not read the References.`, and meaning lane status `ok`. The accepted Reference titled `I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it’s everywhere)` exists: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UytYrhYLOKI. It is the oldest accepted video Reference (created 2026-11-04). The failure is reported by the live searchReferences service, not established as a local CLI parsing problem. Search A #1247 and Search B #1248 are merged into develop and included in main release #1255, but the deployed site backend version and root cause have not been established. Inspect backend logs and site deployment/index state without assuming missing index, permissions, or a particular exception. The MCP feature branch has search integration; verify whether its tool uses the same searchReferences operation and preserves partial lane failure; MCP impact has not yet been reproduced. Coordinate with ongoing search/MCP work and avoid duplicate implementation.

Feature: A signed-in editor can find an existing Reference by an exact title word
  Scenario: The exact title word finds the video
    Given the publication has an accepted Reference titled I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location
    When an editor searches for sound
    Then the word search succeeds and returns that Reference as a title match
  Scenario: The search backend cannot read its word index
    Given the word-search backend cannot read its index
    When an editor searches for sound through any supported client
    Then the client reports the word-search failure distinctly from an empty result
    And any available meaning results remain visible
  Scenario: CLI and MCP share the behavior
    Given the same authorized user and publication
    When the user searches the same query through CLI and MCP
    Then the exact-word result and lane failure information agree.

Do not expose private Reference content or user credentials in diagnostics.
